caption: The drawing shows a small, rectangular stool with a cushioned seat and four curved wooden legs. The legs are wide and flare out at the base, and they are connected near the bottom by a horizontal support beam. The legs are brown, showing a wood grain texture, and the cushion is gray. There is an embroidered design centered on the seat cushion, featuring a red and yellow bird with blue wings, perched on a branch with green leaves and red berries. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a separate, enlarged detail view of just the bird and branch motif, showing its colors more distinctly: red, yellow, green, brown, and blue. The drawing uses colored pencils or similar media, and the main subject is enclosed within a simple rectangular border, with the enlarged motif placed in a smaller, overlapping square at the top right. The bottom of the drawing includes the text “1/4 ACTUAL SIZE” and the name “A. CAMILLI.”
title: Foot Stool
